'''April 2001 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 20 April 2001. [[Chris Shaner]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01d2144/ viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 23 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-23-viper-tracks-phoenix-az-4-20-01d2144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 April 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Shaner]]
